name: insight-cafe
description: Your AI research agency, drawn as an office. Seven specialists named after drinks (four on shift in this free trial) find what's trending, what your competitors did and what's worth doing, then serve it as one page. Open 24/7 on GitHub, live with your calendar, or run it on your computer. Runs on free AI (Gemini or open-source models) or Claude, with your own key.
